purpose: Fresh independent U3 meaning reserve frozen after the clarity and named-prohibition repairs. Mark exposed after first generation run.
evaluationOrder: Freeze corpus and global rubric before production request export and model generation. Report generation, review readiness, and human semantic judgment separately.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: A draft or safe recovery preserves recipient, time direction, amounts, units, identifiers, exact URL/path/flag bytes, negation, uncertainty, conditions, action status, and the final explicit correction.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed or missing recipient, fact, restriction, condition, uncertainty, exact technical literal, or action status; invented completion or send claim; unsupported content reaching review.
semanticCriteria.minor: Style or task-format weakness without meaning change.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 20 cases have zero critical semantic errors and zero exact-literal violations. Safe rejection is recorded separately from a successful draft.
